steps.content:
The root cause is instance family **HRNHGYQxfj** (application ap3, cloud service h92it). Total spend for CZ4NH6K went up by about $1,080 from 2025-10-12 to 2025-10-13, and this one instance family accounts for $940 of that.

- **Normal pattern:** HRNHGYQxfj follows a weekly cycle. It runs about $209–244 on Mondays and Tuesdays, rises to about $905–940 midweek, and settles at about $450–490 late in the week and over the weekend.
- **What changed:** On Monday 2025-10-13 it jumped to about $1,427, roughly six times its usual Monday cost and above any day in the earlier history. It then stayed flat at about $1,427 every day through 2025-11-02, so the weekly cycle stopped and the higher cost became the new baseline.
- **Where it shows up:** The same jump is visible higher up. Application ap3 went from about $574 to $1,517, and cloud service h92it went from about $1,312 to $2,393.

The next-largest increase that day was instance family vhnT3Q7AY2 (+$164, from $17 to $181). I left it out because that is its normal Monday level; it hits $181–190 every Monday and Tuesday. The other instance families moved by about $12 or less in either direction.
